complexity.notes: Clean and idiomatic. Worst case is theoretical: the map has only 3 keys, so adversarial hash collisions degrading lookups to O(n) per lookup are not realistically reachable, but per the dict-based analysis the worst case is O(n^2).
complexity.summary: Classic stack-based validation: push opening brackets, and on each closing bracket pop and check that it matches via a closing-to-opening map. Returns true only if the stack is empty at the end and no mismatch occurred.
